## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Puerto del Carmen, Spain. It starts at s/n Calle Alcalde Cabrera Torres.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Rancho Texas Lanzarote Park is the perfect place to enjoy different activities during your vacation. Whether discovering new animals, zipping down waterslides, seeing a live show with birds of prey, or simply relaxing poolside.
>
> With Rancho Texas Lanzarote Park tickets you can discover curious animals such as the Andean Condor, and different reptiles like the alligator tortoise, and the Gila monster.
>
> There are also several live shows, including exhibitions featuring birds of prey and dolphins!
>
> Rancho Texas Lanzarote Park has several themed environments with varied activities such as the Gold Mine, where you can sift for treasure, and the Indian Lagoon which lets you hop in a kayak and paddle past a waterfall.
>
> Don't forget your towel so you can make the most of Rancho Texas Lanzarote Park's tanning beds and swimming pools!
>
> Enjoy heated swimming pools powered by geothermal and solar energy, ensuring a comfortable swim in any weather using clean energy.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €50.62. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 235 ratings and 111 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
